item.title: App7 — language learning from reading (project write-up)
item.author: Bernardo Stearns
item.description:
App7 — language learning from reading (project write-up)

!!! abstract "TL;DR"

- a **Kotlin Multiplatform comic reader** (Android + desktop) where every speech bubble is a lesson. - **OCR-enriched pages**, tap-to-annotate tokens, machine-translation zoom. - built solo in **~5 months**, shipped behind a mechanical release gate.

item.title: Hive Mind — a feed algorithm you own (project write-up)
item.author: Bernardo Stearns
item.description:
Hive Mind — a feed algorithm you own (project write-up)

!!! abstract "TL;DR"

- a **browser extension** that uses your own recommendation model to filter major feed platforms. - trained on **your annotations** and those of a small circle of people you trust. - all served on **your own compute**.
